subject: MAP: Legal & Procurement onboarding triage (BrightGrid)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Legal & Procurement onboarding triage (BrightGrid)

Team —

Quick MAP checkpoint ahead of tomorrow's sync with BrightGrid. Attached are the current artifacts (MSA redlines v1, order form draft, vendor onboarding checklist). High level:

- MSA: Legal returned initial redlines; key concerns are data usage scope, indemnity cap, and DPA incorporation. See attached PDF (BrightGrid_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf) for inline comments.
- Order form: Sales populated pricing and seats but procurement needs vendor tax + PO terms before finalizing. Draft attached (BrightGrid_OrderForm_Draft.docx).
- Vendor setup: BrightGrid requires W9, insurance cert, and completion of vendor portal. Vendor checklist attached (VendorOnboardingChecklist.xlsx).

Action items I want visible before our Friday close call:
1) Marcus: propose fallback language for indemnity and data-use carveouts — due Wed EOD (assigning to legal).
2) Neha: confirm whether finance can accept BrightGrid's standard 30-net terms and whether we need a PO in place — due Thu noon.
3) Marissa: update order form pricing line items based on the negotiated demo credits — due Thu EOD.
4) Rishi: start vendor onboarding in the portal (I'll loop BrightGrid contact) — kick-off today.

Erin (cc'd when we loop externally) — if you can confirm the vendor portal link and expected SLA for vendor verification, that will help set expectations.

I'll call out any non-starters in tomorrow's sync.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BrightGrid_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf (annotated), BrightGrid_OrderForm_Draft.docx, VendorOnboardingChecklist.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Legal & Procurement onboarding triage (BrightGrid)

Lauren — thanks for the summary and attachments. Quick legal read-through and notes inline: 

- Indemnity: BrightGrid's redline removes our cap on indirect damages — non-starter. I'll propose a mutual cap tied to fees and carve out IP infringement; target language by Wed morning.
- Data use / retention: they're added broad sharing language. We need explicit DPA referencing GDPR- and CCPA-compliant controls; I'll add appendix references.
- Subprocessors: require notification and 30-day cure window.

I'm assigning the following on my side:
- Marcus (legal): draft counterproposal for indemnity + subprocessors (due Wed 11/02 10:00 PT).
- Neha (procurement): please confirm whether finance can accept vendor-supplied insurance certs (we may require Redwood CA on COI). If finance needs a specific format, we'll request it from BrightGrid today.

Also: small ask on the order form — include an explicit termination-for-convenience clause and limit on demo credits usage. Marissa, can you add those lines to the order form draft and re-upload?

(On a related note, if they're insisting on our internal telemetry sharing for diagnostics, we should gate that behind a documented SSO+logged-access requirement.)

From: Erin Stone <erin.stone@brightgrid.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightgrid.com>, procurement@brightgrid.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Legal & Procurement onboarding triage (BrightGrid)

Hi Lauren / team —

Thanks for the clear rundown. A few points from BrightGrid procurement/legal to unblock things quickly: 

1) Vendor portal: https://vendorportal.brightgrid.com/setup/FG-8892 — you can create the vendor record and upload W9 + COI there. Verification usually completes within 48 business hours, faster if everything is uploaded at once.
2) Payment terms: BrightGrid can accept Net-30 on first purchase for new partners; larger enterprise customers are typically Net-45 after credit review. If Redwood prefers Net-30, we can confirm in the SOW.
3) MSA redlines: appreciate the annotated PDF. Our legal prefers a short summary of 'non-negotiables' rather than line-by-line markup; to speed this up, we've highlighted three sections in our copy (indemnity, data sharing, audit rights). If you can send a one-page summary of Redwood's counterpositions, we can respond more quickly.
4) DocuSign: sales order link (fillable) — https://docusign.com/salesorder/BD-55433. We can prepare the final SO once MSA terms are agreed.

Attachments: vendor_portal_screenshot.png (portal UI), BrightGrid_PO_Terms.pdf (standard PO template).

Next steps from BrightGrid: Samir (procurement) and I will verify the vendor record once Rishi uploads documents. Happy to join a call Thursday AM if that helps accelerate signatures.

Best,
Erin Stone
Head of Strategic Partnerships
BrightGrid
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Erin Stone <erin.stone@brightgrid.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Legal & Procurement onboarding triage (BrightGrid)

Erin — great, thanks for the portal link and clarity on terms. Quick confirmations and updated MAP actions: 

- Marcus will send a 1-page counterposition summary focused on indemnity, data sharing scope, and subprocessors by Wed 11/02 10:00 PT.
- Neha will confirm finance's acceptance of Net-30 and whether a PO is required by Thu 11/03 12:00 PT.
- Marissa will update the order form (add termination-for-convenience clause + demo credit limits) and re-upload by Thu EOD.
- Rishi will create the vendor record in BrightGrid's portal and upload W9 + COI today; expected vendor verification by Fri.

I've scheduled a 30-minute MAP checkpoint on Thu 11/03 at 9:30 AM PT to confirm outstanding items and, if green, authorize DocuSign SO creation. If anyone needs time adjustments, ping me.

Thanks everyone — moving to 'ready for signature' is our goal for next week.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
